verdict.overall: The biggest movers since Sunday are ZETA (+6.6%), TSLA (+4.9%) and PLTR (+5.1%), all swinging up into resistance zones with earnings or crowded, pricey options ahead, so confidence in chasing those ranges is shaky. AVGO and MU look like the steadiest range setups with wide, calm floor-to-ceiling bands and no near-term earnings shock, while PLTR, ZETA and NVDA look weakest given opposing positioning and pricey options stacking up into earnings. Main caution across the board: earnings for AMD, PLTR, ZETA, NVDA and AMAT all land within the next four weeks, and several names already carry pricey options layered on top of that risk.

tickers.TSLA: Since Sunday: stronger, price up nearly 5% to 371.95, though it has cooled a bit from midweek highs. Floor near 340-350 and ceiling 400 still frame the range, but two of the next four weeks show opposing pressure, so upside may stall.
tickers.AVGO: Since Sunday: weaker, price down about 1.6% to 323.63 with a downtrend and soft RSI. Floor 320 and ceiling 350 have held steady across recent scans, suggesting an orderly range rather than a breakdown.
tickers.META: No Sunday baseline. Price 645.46 after earnings already passed, trend down with soft RSI. Magnet levels have been drifting lower each update (from 705 toward 680 area), floor near 600 and ceiling 700, hinting at a cooling range.
tickers.AMD: No Sunday baseline. Price 517.4, up from the prior run, but earnings land 11-03 inside this window. Ceiling has shifted up to 595 for early November while floor holds near 460-475, keeping a wide but earnings-risky range.
tickers.MU: No Sunday baseline. Price 877.69, up from the prior run, trend down but magnets and floor near 800-950 have stayed fairly stable, pointing to an orderly range with no earnings until December.
tickers.PLTR: Since Sunday: stronger, price up about 5.1% to 195.47. Earnings hit 11-02, and later weeks turn opposing with pricey options, so the floor near 190 and ceiling 205-215 may get tested hard around results.
tickers.NVDA: Since Sunday: slightly weaker, price down about 1.1% to 211.87 with a downtrend and soft RSI. Options are pricey across all four weeks, ceiling has been pulled in toward 225, and earnings on 11-17 add extra risk late in the window.
tickers.ZETA: Since Sunday: stronger, price up 6.6% to 33.9, but three of four weeks are opposing and options are very pricey, especially around earnings on 11-03. Floor near 30 and ceiling 35-38 frame a volatile range.
tickers.AMAT: No Sunday baseline. Price roughly flat near 378.88, but trend is down with a very oversold RSI, and magnet levels have dropped sharply (from 440 toward 422.5, and 520 toward 455), hinting at fading upside into 11-12 earnings.
